product.title: Parasailing along Fort Lauderdale Beach

description.text: See the beauty of Fort Lauderdale from a brand new vantage point with this small-group parasailing adventure over the Atlantic Ocean. The captain assesses the weather and takes you to an area that’s optimal for parasailing. Then, enjoy a worry-free tour with a life vest, harness, and all the equipment you need provided.Perfect for thrill seekers—soar above the water in Fort Lauderdale The group size is kept small to ensure a more intimate experience Beginner-friendly session: An instructor provides assistance Access spectacular aerial views that you’d miss otherwise Ideal for groups on Fort Lauderdale's Intracoastal Waterway who want a private captain without handling marina logistics.
